html:
experiments/star-field/engine/registry-body.ts

Lazy registry-body spawner — the 139,563-record deep
Source src/experiments/star-field/engine/registry-body.ts
UX surface Boot surfaces: what the user sees first on each bundle.

Members

_SPECTRAL_TINT

Spectral-class → palette tint — the HYG s field leads with the Harvard letter (O B A F G K M); a record with no usable class falls back to the white mid-ramp. Colors come from the shared B-V ramp tokens so the spawned star matches the cloud's own color grading.

_EXO_TINTS

Exoplanet palettes — seeded pick between a rocky tint and a gas-giant tint; members come from the authored exoplanet palette so spawned worlds sit in the same color space as the catalog's own TRAPPIST/Kepler planets.

_DSO_TINTS

OpenNGC type-code → tint. t carries the catalogue's short type string (G/Gx galaxies, OC/** clusters, PN/RN nebulae, SNR remnants); unmapped codes keep the cloud's own DSO point tint so a spawned object matches the point it replaces.

starTint

Resolves the spectral tint for a star record — first letter of the Harvard class (s = "G2V" → G) through the shared ramp.

  • @param rec Registry record.

dsoTint

Resolves the DSO tint by scanning the record's OpenNGC type code against the ordered match table (first hit wins — SNR before G so a remnant never reads as a galaxy).

  • @param rec Registry record.

starRadius

Magnitude → chart radius for a spawned star — real discs scale with luminosity, so a Sirius-class record (mag −1) draws the largest disc the clamps allow while a mag-9 dwarf stays a hard point with a halo.

  • @param m Apparent magnitude (null/absent → mid-curve).

buildStar

Registry star — a fresnel-limb photosphere sphere (same shader the authored stars use) tinted by spectral class with a seeded granulation surface texture, plus the additive halo sprite so the selected star reads as a point source at cloud range.

  • @param THREE The three.js module.
  • @param s Engine state (deps + glowTex).
  • @param rec The registry record.

buildExoplanet

Registry exoplanet — a lit sphere whose surface is the shared seeded procedural texture (mottle/bands/streaks keyed on the record id), so each of the 5,974 catalogued worlds gets its own terrain instead of the same painted ball. Tint picks seeded from the exoplanet palette.

  • @param THREE The three.js module.
  • @param rec The registry record.

buildDso

Registry deep-sky object — a seeded elliptical speckle cloud (the same fillElliptical the authored dwarf galaxies use, so a catalog galaxy/cluster resolves as a resolved member swarm, not a billboard) plus an additive halo sprite tinted by the OpenNGC type code.

  • @param THREE The three.js module.
  • @param s Engine state (glowTex).
  • @param rec The registry record.

disposeRegistryTree

Disposes every geometry/material/owned texture under a spawned registry group — canvas-generated textures (procedural surfaces) are theirs to release; the shared glowTex sprite is excluded so eviction never corrupts the scene's shared sprite.

  • @param s Engine state (shared glowTex to exclude).
  • @param root The spawned group to strip.

ensureRegistryBody

Materializes the rendered body for a catalog record at its true heliocentric chart position — the object the cloud point stands in for. LRU-cached on s.registryBodies; a cache overflow evicts and disposes the oldest spawn so mesh count stays bounded. No-ops on missing THREE/deps (pre-boot), missing Sun pivot, or dispose.

  • @param s Engine state.
  • @param rec The resolved registry record.

disposeRegistryBodies

Strips every spawned registry body — engine teardown and any context-loss path call this so the LRU set can't leak GPU buffers.

  • @param s Engine state.
